main.description: An app installed in a workspace: written by the workspace authority in the workspace space, keyed by the app's DID. It is the grant. An active install makes the app a reader of the workspace space and a member of each channel listed, with write where granted. Clients read it to mark the account as an app.

channelGrant.description: One channel an app may read, and write when `write` is true. There is no write-only grant.
